methods.name: CD-AHP (Change Detection and Analytic Hierarchy Process)
methods.summary: A landslide detection method that combines change detection (CD) on dual-temporal quad-pol SAR datasets to identify modified regions, and an analytic hierarchy process (AHP) based on Yamaguchi decomposition (YD) to identify surface scattering mechanisms, fused by a logical 'AND' operation to remove false alarms.
methods.source: Nielsen, A. A. (for CD MATLAB codes)
methods.verbatim: Furthermore, the authors express gratitude to the contribution of Nielsen, A. A. from the Technical University of Denmark (DTU) for sharing the MATLAB codes of the CD using polarimetric SAR datasets.

reproducibility_assessment: The landslide inventory is not referenced or linked, and the custom code used for the CD-AHP method lacks a repository or persistent link.
